text:
elaine: Heads-up — hotfix PR needs 2x LGTM before cutoff in ~45m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8347 — fixes KV cache eviction bug causing cold-start token blowup. Low-risk but regresses without the fix. Can someone take a quick pass? I’ll squash + add changelog after reviews. :clock45:
sanjay: On it. starting local run now, will ping when tests pass.
devon: I’ll do a quick review too; can you add a one-liner in the PR description about risk/rollback steps?
elaine: added rollback note and replay steps — thanks.
maya: CI flaked earlier on style lint but looks unrelated to the fix. re-running now. If tests are green I’m happy to approve.
jenkins-bot: Build #1423 started for PR 8347 — running unit tests and e2e smoke. ETA ~6m
sanjay: tests green locally; left one comment about a tiny nit in comment. otherwise LGTM from me. :+1:
devon: skimmed, nit addressed. LGTM, will approve once CI finishes.
jamie: I can push the second approval after a quick staging smoke (5m) — reminder we’d like to keep cutoff at 21:30 UTC. @ops-oncall any concerns about doing the hotfix in that window?
ops-oncall: go for it — no maintenance windows. coordinate rollback tag 'hotfix-8347' if needed and ping me before merge. :white_check_mark:
elaine: Thanks all — I’ll merge on green and tag, then kick the deploy. Will post final merge ts here. :rocket:
